d: London's sky cops are back with fifteen million pounds worth of new helicopter's to help them in their fight against crime in the capital; including a dangerous blackmailer whose reckless driving is threatening to cause death and destruction.
Stephen Lawrence's family reflects on his murder.
Raoul Moat's shooting spree.
Garry Newlove's widow reflects on her husband's murder.
Arguably Britain's most infamous serial killer, Peter Sutcliffe became known as The Yorkshire Ripper when he began murdering women in Yorkshire during the 1970s.
Failed businessman Christopher Foster kills his wife and daughter before burning their mansion in Shropshire to the ground in August 2008.
Colin Ireland stalked gay men in London in the 1990s, lured them back to his flat and brutally murdered them.
Searching for a flamboyant lawyer's killer, investigators must unravel a complex mystery involving a deadly love triangle, and a nationwide manhunt for an unexpected killer.
The body of aspiring singer Heather Stigliano is found in her Myrtle Beach, S.C., apartment; bloody footprints tell investigators they're looking for a suspect with size 11 feet.
A murdered woman is found floating near the yacht club at Newport Beach, Calif.; after the coroner identifies the victim, it's up to detectives to track down her missing teenage daughter.

The bodies of three young women are discovered in Washington; though it's clear there's a serial killer on the loose, it will take a missing ring, traces of blood and a coroner's expertise to tie the crimes together.
When a leg washes ashore in Lake Ontario, detectives suspect that a fellow police officer has committed a heinous murder; it's up to the medical examiner to link the officer to the severed leg.
After a mail-order bride goes missing in Texas, detectives learn that her husband's ex-wives died under suspicious circumstances.

When a human skull is discovered at a Boy Scout camp in Missouri, detectives struggle to connect the dots; a renowned forensic pathologist joins the team and learns the dead woman's story from beyond the grave.

Alabama police are obsessed with the execution-style shooting of an all-American college student; however, it will take decades before a cutting-edge forensic facility leads the police to a shocking conclusion.
Mummified remains are discovered in an abandoned garage in Nebraska; after a nationwide manhunt finally leads to the alleged killer, it's up to science to catch him in a lie.
The cameras are allowed into the London Sky Cops unit for the first time.
Sky Cops unit tries to keep the peace and catch criminals.

Police deal with motorbike madness and a man reportedly threatening people with a blade; the Hammersmith and Fulham drugs squad raid two suspected drug dealers they believe are supplying London's clubbers.
In the West of London, police are scouring marsh land for a wanted man.
